verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.rippling.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) titled 'Rippling Developer Documentation'. Its agent-directed instructions (e.g., check the npm registry for the latest package versions) show it is written for agents, and it sits alongside developer documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's full scope and structure (e.g., coverage of API reference pages or an llms-full.txt), other agent-oriented doc formats, and independent corroboration of agents using it successfully.
